changeSet.author: janes
changeSet.sql: UPDATE eventconf_events SET xml_content = REPLACE( xml_content, 'clear-key="uei.opennms.org/vendor/APC/traps/upsOnBattery:%dpname%:%nodeid%:%interface%"', 'clear-key="uei.opennms.org/vendor/APC/traps/communicationLost:%dpname%:%nodeid%:%interface%"' ), last_modified = NOW() WHERE uei = 'uei.opennms.org/vendor/APC/traps/communicationEstablished' AND POSITION('clear-key="uei.opennms.org/vendor/APC/traps/upsOnBattery:%dpname%:%nodeid%:%interface%"' IN xml_content) > 0; UPDATE eventconf_sources SET last_modified = NOW() WHERE id IN (SELECT source_id FROM eventconf_events WHERE uei = 'uei.opennms.org/vendor/APC/traps/communicationEstablished' AND last_modified = NOW());
